why_blocked.reason: pg_policies is a view in the pg_catalog schema. PostgREST only exposes the schemas configured for the API (public, graphql_public), so pg_catalog is unreachable over the REST endpoint even when authenticating with the service_role key. service_role bypasses row-level security; it does not expose new schemas.
